[PARTY_B] will be fully responsible for the settlement of, and shall indemnify ("vrijwaren") T-Mobile against any claims made by [PARTY_B] Customers or third parties with whom [PARTY_B] has a (contractual) relationship and which claims are related to this (contractual) relationship
findings.explanation: This clause imposes an unlimited, uncapped indemnification obligation on me for any claims by my customers or third parties, exposing my business to severe financial risk.
findings.suggested_change: Cap the indemnification obligation and exclude claims resulting directly from T-Mobile's own network failures or wrongful acts.

findings.quoted_text: Notwithstanding anything stipulated in the Agreement, T-Mobile may without liability suspend or terminate whole or part of the Hosting Services in relation to one or more [PARTY_B] Customers, in circumstances where T-Mobile would suspend or terminate those services to its own customers, in the following circumstances - or circumstances of similar severity.
findings.explanation: T-Mobile has the unilateral right to suspend or terminate services without liability based on vague criteria, disrupting my business operations without recourse.
findings.suggested_change: Require advance written notice, a clear opportunity to cure alleged issues, and restrict suspension/termination to objective, material breaches.

findings.quoted_text: The second installment of *** shall be charged to [PARTY_B] right after signing of the Agreement and shall be paid by [PARTY_B] within fifteen (15) Calendar Days of the invoice date.
findings.explanation: Short payment windows combined with strict interest penalties for late payments create cash flow pressure before commercial revenues begin.
findings.suggested_change: Extend payment terms to at least 30 calendar days from invoice receipt and remove punitive interest rates.

findings.quoted_text: Should [PARTY_B] wilfully or negligently fail to comply with an T-Mobile request, [PARTY_B] shall bear full responsibility and indemnify T- Mobile for all damages and losses T-Mobile suffers resulting from actions as mentioned in this article by [PARTY_B]'s Customers.
findings.explanation: I am held fully liable and required to indemnify T-Mobile for all damages and losses caused by customers due to alleged negligence, without any liability cap.
findings.suggested_change: Limit liability to direct damages caused by willful misconduct and subject it to the overall agreement liability cap.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to our collaboration, but I would like to propose a few adjustments before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on indemnification, the agreement imposes an unlimited and uncapped obligation for third-party claims, and I propose to cap this obligation and exclude claims resulting directly from network failures or wrongful acts. - In the relevant clause regarding service suspension and termination, the agreement grants unilateral rights without liability based on vague criteria, and I propose requiring advance written notice, a clear opportunity to cure alleged issues, and restricting suspension or termination to objective, material breaches. - Under the relevant clause concerning payment terms, short payment windows combined with strict interest penalties create cash flow pressure, and I propose extending payment terms to at least 30 calendar days from invoice receipt and removing punitive interest rates. - In the relevant clause regarding liability and damages, the agreement holds me fully liable and requires indemnification for all customer-related damages without a liability cap, and I propose limiting liability to direct damages caused by willful misconduct and subjecting it to the overall agreement liability cap. Best regards,
